content.english: When you are in rage, remember to have compassion. (Habakkuk 3:2)
When you are in rage, remember to have compassion.
When you are in rage — for the throne of glory, lofty from the very beginning (Jeremiah 17:12),
remember to have compassion.

content.hebrew: בְּרֹגֶז מְעוֹן בֵּיתְךָ וּמְקוֹם מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶךָ
content.transliteration: Beroḡez me‘on betecha umḳom mishkan kevodecha
content.english: When you are in rage — for the habitation of your house and the place where your glorious presence dwells (Psalms 26:8),
remember to have compassion.
When you are in rage — for the place that you made for your dwelling, O Adonai (Exodus 15:17),
remember to have compassion.
When you are in rage — for the Temple, O Adonai, that your hands established (Exodus 15:17, continued),
remember to have compassion.
When you are in rage — for Mt. Zion, on the north side (Psalms 48:3),
remember to have compassion.
When you are in rage — for the city of the great king (Psalms 48:3, continued),
remember to have compassion.
When you are in rage — for the holy city (Isaiah 52:1),
remember to have compassion.
When you are in rage — for Mt. Moriah (II Chronicles 3:1),
remember to have compassion.
When you are in rage — for the place called Adonai Will See (Genesis 22:14),
remember to have compassion.
When you are in rage — [in the merit of] Abraham’s covenant,
remember to have compassion.
When you are in rage — [in the merit of] Isaac’s Binding,
remember to have compassion.
When you are in rage — [in the merit of] Jacob’s Innocence,
remember to have compassion.
When you are in rage with your wrath and anger,
remember to have compassion.
When you are in rage with your outrage and your ire,
remember to have compassion.
When you are in rage, for the exiles of your whole people,
remember to have compassion.
